purpose: Torrevieja Round-3 aligned scenario crop metadata

stopPlaceSafety.verificationBasis: Current public torrevieja-legacy-all-v1 stopPlaces were reviewed as the full old-line StopPlace superset. All recorded StopPlace positions are within the shared declared viewport; therefore the route-used StopPlace subsets for ABC, East, South, North, and All are within both the viewport and the larger aligned crop. derive-pop-grid-crops.ts mirrors the repository route-used StopPlace rule for an exact per-package rerun against a local public-scenarios tree.
